escalations.title: Handlebars.js Multiple RCE Vulnerabilities (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.exploit_scenario: Template rendered from user-controlled input executes arbitrary JavaScript server-side

escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read and Execute (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.fix: npm update vitest >= 3.2.6 or >= 4.1.9 in Source/Frontend
escalations.exploit_scenario: HTTP client on network reads/executes arbitrary files when Vitest UI server is running

p1_findings.title: GET /api/search not registered in app.ts — all typeahead calls return 404
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: User opens DependencyPicker, all searchItems() calls return 404 silently. Dependency linking is completely broken at runtime.
p1_findings.impact: FR-dependency-search requirement unmet. All users of dependency management feature cannot create relationships via typeahead.
p1_findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts and add app.use('/api/search', searchRouter) in app.ts.

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer fallback always picks stale requirements.md — CI reports PASSED with 89 FR IDs untraced
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: CI gate passes green. dev-workflow-platform.md (76 FR IDs) and tiered-merge-pipeline.md (13 FR IDs) never enter coverage window. Spec debt accumulates invisibly.
p1_findings.impact: Architecture rule 'every FR needs a test with // Verifies: FR-XXX' is not enforced for 87% of the spec corpus.
p1_findings.recommendation: Add --all-specs flag or update CLAUDE.md CI gate to run enforcer against each Specifications/ file explicitly.

p2_findings.title: 3 route files bypass service layer with direct store calls
p2_findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/services/workItemService.ts. Route all three handlers through it.

p2_findings.title: Specifications/tiered-merge-pipeline.md — 13 FR-TMP-* IDs with 0% implementation coverage
p2_findings.recommendation: Tag spec [Status: Planned — not yet started] or open a Plans/tiered-merge-pipeline/ entry with FR-TMP-* IDs mapped to implementation tasks.

p2_findings.title: Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md — FR-001–FR-069 (76 IDs) with 0% implementation coverage
p2_findings.recommendation: Tag spec [Status: Future] if aspirational; clarify relationship to workflow-engine.md which is the current implementation.

p2_findings.title: dependencyCheckDuration Histogram missing from metrics.ts (FR-dependency-metrics partial)
p2_findings.recommendation: Add Histogram import and define dependencyCheckDurationHistogram in metrics.ts. Instrument BFS call in dependency.ts.

p2_findings.title: Duplicate test files: WorkItemDetailPage and WorkItemListPage in both tests/ and tests/pages/
p2_findings.recommendation: Delete root-level duplicates; keep Source/Frontend/tests/pages/ variants as canonical.

p2_findings.title: FR-dependency-seed: no seed.ts — fresh server has no demo dependency data
p2_findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/seed.ts with idempotent seeding. Wire into startup with SEED_DATA=true guard.

p2_findings.title: form-data CRLF Injection (CVSS 7.5, GHSA-hmw2-7cc7-3qxx)
p2_findings.fix: npm update form-data >= 4.0.6 in both modules

p3_findings.title: eslint-disable react-hooks/exhaustive-deps in 2 files — potential stale closures
p3_findings.recommendation: Replace suppressions with proper useCallback/useMemo patterns or documented justification comments.

p3_findings.title: DebugPortalPage.tsx has no FR-backed spec reference
p3_findings.recommendation: Add FR entry or mark as '// Dev tooling only — not part of the product spec'.

p3_findings.title: dependency-linking requirements.md references portal/ paths instead of Source/
p3_findings.recommendation: Replace all portal/Backend/ → Source/Backend/, portal/Frontend/ → Source/Frontend/, portal/Shared/ → Source/Shared/.

cross_reference_map.single_fix: Add npm audit --audit-level=high to CI; run npm update across both modules
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Clears all 11 dependency CVEs (2 P1 escalations + 3 P2 + 6 P3). Eliminates grade-D drivers.

cross_reference_map.single_fix: Update enforcer to scan all Specifications/ files or update CI gate
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Resolves false-green CI gate; surfaces 89 untraced FR IDs as explicit debt.

cross_reference_map.root_cause: Missing service layer for CRUD and search
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Create workItemService.ts + register search.ts router in app.ts
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Fixes runtime 404 on all typeahead calls AND decouples 3 route handlers from the store.

grading_breakdown.bottleneck: P1 count (4) exceeds C threshold of max 2
grading_breakdown.path_to_C: Fix QO-001 (register search route), QO-002 (enforcer fix), DEP-001 (upgrade handlebars), DEP-002 (upgrade vitest) — reduces P1 count to 0, P2 count to 9 → grade C
